scope: Actually read latest comment in each observed bank/store/rating stratum; targeted limitations recorded, not an independent human accuracy study.

reviews.notes: The writer reports force closing after an update and inability to manage the app. One star and a stability mention fit; the update is a reported trigger, not a proven cause.

The complaint is a messy layout and difficulty finding functions. Usability fits. Helpful triggers customer support although no support interaction is described; the support tag is a keyword false positive.
The writer requests visibility of a typed password. Access and feature-request tags fit. Four stars are a positive rating proxy; the request itself is not unqualified praise.
Easy to use thanks is explicit positive usability feedback and agrees with five stars. The text supplies no specific journey or defect.
Poor verification process is a clear negative authentication comment consistent with one star, but gives no step or error details.
The writer dislikes complexity and FX advertising. Usability fits; fees/rates is triggered by FX and ads but is not evidence of a fee or exchange-rate complaint.
The review suggests hiding the welcome-screen name for privacy. Security fits. The narrow feature-request patterns miss should remove; three stars stay neutral by the stated rating convention.
The body calls screenshot restrictions frustrating while the rating is four stars. Retain the positive star proxy and negative text signal separately. Feature request fits the screenshot wording.
Best services, systems and app is positive and agrees with five stars. The singular service pattern misses services, leaving no theme. This is a coverage limitation, not no service feedback.

Not user friendly is negative usability feedback consistent with one star. The text lexicon outputs mixed because its simple negation rule misses user between not and friendly; it is not reliable sentiment inference.
The user cannot upload a document and keeps restarting. The explicit user-experience tag fits. The rules do not separately identify the upload journey or prove an account-opening failure.
Face recognition is poor is negative text with a three-star neutral proxy. The explicit V2 face-recognition addition correctly places it in authentication; the discrepancy remains visible.
Good agrees with four stars but provides no banking journey or topic. Leave themes empty rather than infer a service or performance compliment.
Very good agrees with five stars. This short praise has insufficient evidence for a specific issue or business theme.

The body reports changing layout, tiny fonts and difficulty locating a credit-card suspension action during suspected fraud. Usability, cards and security all fit one-star negative feedback; no fraud event is verified.

The transfer page reportedly will not load. Title and body jointly support stability and transfers, consistent with two stars. The author's speculation about blocking withdrawals is not established fact.
The writer reports a questionnaire extending beyond the iPhone viewport and difficulty finding close. Usability fits. The text is critical despite a neutral three-star rating.
Easy to use and user-friendly are positive interface feedback consistent with four stars. The Apple title usefully supplies the exact easy-to-use keyword.
Easy to make and the title Easy are positive but vague. Five stars fit; no specific banking action should be inferred from this short text.
The writer complains about an unspecified error message. One star and the error-based stability tag fit, while the actual technical root cause remains unknown.
Pls stop and too frequent ID or email checking express negative friction consistent with two stars. The narrow V2 checking phrase captures the access/verification topic.

The writer proposes combining banking, rewards, PayMe and investment apps to reduce storage use. The V2 suggest/combine patterns capture a feature request. Three stars are neutral by rating, not approval of the current design.

The title and body report inability to buy stock with unclear guidance, despite four stars. The existing eleven themes lack an investment-trading category and leave this unclassified; it is still a real comment to review.
Nice and Good are consistent five-star praise. They do not support a specific banking-topic tag.

The user reports repeated failure to scan HKID and provides a phone model. One star fits; the V2 HKID-scan phrase places this in identity/access. It does not establish the precise onboarding step or device cause.

The title suggests improvement and the body asks for one-click card payment. Transfers/cards and the explicit V2 suggest/consider feature-request tag fit. Three stars are neutral by the rating convention.

The body is only V, but the title reports a missing balance during transfer. Transfer and balance tags depend on the preserved title and are justified. Four stars remain positive by rating despite the critical title.
Seems easy and first time term deposit are positive and agree with five stars. The broad transfers/payments/cards bucket matches deposit; this is not a payment failure or complaint.
